cohort: Exact reused Round02 cohort; exploratory new feature screen, not independent replication
decision: Primary action_pairs gain >= .003, both folds nonnegative and no pooled order decline permits separate cohort/window confirmation only. No tuning on this cohort, no automatic promotion or submission.
data_source: Existing cutoff-certified baseline retrieval/history_tail.parquet; not raw JSON and never test files
arms_note: 27 action-pair-specific features versus 9 action-collapsed features. Both use the same adjacent-edge rule; typed versus collapsed is a dimensionality-changing information ablation, not a width-matched placebo.
transition_edges: Original adjacent event indices only, directed, different items, gap <=30min; once per session/item-pair/action-pair
